meta.title: Mapping Voices — an atlas of oral-history archives
meta.description: An interactive atlas of real oral-history and voice-testimony archive collections, filterable by country, theme, language, and decade.

map.ariaLabel: Map of oral-history and voice-testimony collections. Each pin is keyboard-focusable and announces the collection it represents.
map.hint: Tab through the map to reach each pin, or use the index to browse by list.
map.loadError: Couldn't load the collections dataset ({url}). If you're running this locally, check that a {url} file exists next to index.html.

detail.heading: About this collection
detail.placeholder: Select a pin on the map, or an entry from the index, to read about it here.

footer.template: Map data & imagery © %LINK% contributors. Mapping Voices is a seed/demo atlas — see the README for how to add a collection.
